notes.title: Quality of Life Game Update
notes.notes:
hello everyone,

We are here to update you on a few things without going into much detail right now.

We want to share with you. we have had  long meetings pouring over all the feedback and the  reports that have been coming in.

So  you know we have been listening going forward we are moving directions for the game

we are going to be bringing in new improvements

This will come in another update once these things are ready to push out to you all.

Let us just say these will improve allot of the situations with pricing and more as time goes on.

You will also Notice the events are a bit all over the place right now, not to worry this is only short term. 

This will allow new events and new people to be trained up and be ready to be with you at Events.

Also coming as part of the changes we will be Retiring the Escort Badge, this is being done to make way for the new system changes,
currently in the works and will make more sense once these updates active.

We will be then looking to hire services from people for special events etc that require pole dancers, escorts etc on a outsource basis.
More details will come soon once the systems are ready and are in place.

Things regarding Premium are changing these will make it much more easier for a player to use and  be able to do more.
More information will come out when it is ready to roll out.

We are working closely at LoveCraft to make things more robust and make the burden of issues and bugs less on the players.

We will be looking to optimise, repair and improve on all current items, transports etc to make them work more smoother for all in the server.

For now this is the information we have and as soon as there is more we will communicate this though out various channels

Enjoy you time at Lovecraft and you will see you around

Form all of the LoveCraft Game Team
